// The unchanged production noxLoadMap body is inserted below. File checks,
// mode lookup, map queueing and notification are declared service boundaries;
// this fixture is not a replacement map loader or a whole-world oracle.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

type gameFlag uint32
func (f gameFlag) Has(mask gameFlag) bool { return f&mask != 0 }
type mapLoadOptions struct { Force bool }
type input struct {
	Name string
	Game, Mode gameFlag
	Force, CheckError, StatError, Pending bool
	Teams int
}
type result struct {
	Error string
	Pending bool
	Busy int
	Map string
	Calls []string
}
var in input
var out result
func call(name string) { out.Calls = append(out.Calls, name) }
var noxflags = struct {
	GameOnline, GameModeCoop, GameModeCoopTeam, GameModeChat, GameModeCTF, GameModeFlagBall gameFlag
	HasGame func(gameFlag) bool
	GetGame func() gameFlag
}{0x2000, 0x800, 0x200, 0x80, 0x20, 0x40,
	func(f gameFlag) bool { return in.Game.Has(f) }, func() gameFlag { return in.Game },
}
var memmap = struct { PtrOff func(int, int) int }{func(base, offset int) int {
	if base != 0x973F18 || offset != 2408 { panic("mode address differs") }
	return 1
}}
func nox_common_checkMapFile(name string) error {
	call("check:"+name)
	if in.CheckError { return errors.New("check failed") }
	return nil
}
func nox_xxx_mapGetTypeMB_4CFFA0(pointer int) gameFlag {
	if pointer != 1 { panic("mode pointer differs") }
	call("mode")
	return in.Mode
}
func nox_xxx_printCentered_445490(text string) { call("message:"+text) }
var strMan = struct { GetStringInFile func(string, string) string }{func(key, file string) string {
	if file != "parsecmd.c" { panic("message resource differs") }
	call("string:"+key)
	return key+":%S"
}}
var maps = struct { Ext string }{".map"}
var datapath = struct { Maps func(string, string) string }{func(name, filename string) string {
	call("path:"+name+"/"+filename)
	return name+"/"+filename
}}
var ifs = struct { Stat func(string) (int, error) }{func(path string) (int, error) {
	call("stat:"+path)
	if in.StatError { return 0, errors.New("stat failed") }
	return 1, nil
}}
var legacy = struct {
	Nox_xxx_wndGuiTeamCreate_4185B0 func()
	Nox_xxx_mapLoadOrSaveMB_4DCC70 func(int)
	Sub_41D650 func()
}{func() { call("create-teams") }, func(v int) { call("busy"); out.Busy=v }, func() { call("pause") }}
func sub_4DCBF0(v int) { call("relocate"); out.Pending=v!=0 }
var noxServer = struct {
	Teams struct { Count func() int }
	SwitchMap func(string)
}{struct { Count func() int }{func() int { call("teams"); return in.Teams }}, func(name string) {
	call("queue")
	out.Map=name
	if out.Busy != 1 { panic("map was queued before busy state") }
}}

// PRODUCTION_NOX_LOAD_MAP

func main() {
	if err:=json.NewDecoder(os.Stdin).Decode(&in); err!=nil { panic(err) }
	out.Pending=in.Pending
	if err:=noxLoadMap(in.Name,mapLoadOptions{Force:in.Force}); err!=nil { out.Error=err.Error() }
	if err:=json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(out); err!=nil { panic(err) }
}
